question: Which proven or authoritative frontend principles should guide the visual redesign of Starport Arcade?

scope.geography_or_context: public game discovery and product/interactive web pages; mobile-first web arcade
exclusions: copying proprietary visual assets or code

claims.claim: A large game catalog benefits from explicit filtering and browse structure so users can narrow choices instead of scanning an undifferentiated list.

sources.support: The public games page exposes platform, price, time, genre, input, multiplayer, accessibility, type and sorting controls before the game grid.

claims.caveat: This is a product pattern observed in the reference, not a controlled usability study.

claims.claim: A product landing page can establish one main proposition first and progressively explain supporting features afterward.

sources.support: The page opens with product identity and primary value proposition, then provides separate sections for spatial audio, fitness, hearing health, battery and other details.

claims.caveat: The page is a commercial product page, so its conversion goals differ from an indie-game catalog.

claims.claim: CSS Grid supports explicit areas, flexible fractional tracks, responsive sizing and controlled layering for responsive page composition.

sources.support: The guide documents grid areas, fr tracks, repeat, minmax, alignment and layering, including responsive/flexible track sizing.

claims.caveat: The guide explains capability, not which composition is aesthetically best.

claims.claim: Responsive design should adapt layout and content presentation to viewport constraints rather than only shrink a desktop layout.

sources.support: The official course is explicitly about sites that look great and work well for everyone across responsive design concerns.

claims.caveat: The landing page alone is a course description; detailed modules were not all fetched in this pass.

claims.claim: The redesigned Starport Arcade should use a single hero focus, a small curated selection, then a filterable catalog; this is a design inference from the references and the observed baseline, not a measured universal rule.
claims.caveat: No independent user study has been run; visual acceptance must be based on actual screenshots and navigation checks.

inaccessible: Steam homepage returned no readable text in the browser session
Awwwards page exposed only a short nominee summary
SiteInspire page exposed only a short listing summary
